Thanks again for the time earlier  great alignment. Quick recap from our call and next steps so everyone is on the same page.

High-level objective:
- Validate Redwood inference for Acme's customer support semantic search pipeline at 99th percentile latency <= 120ms and inference cost target <= $0.0008/token (pilot profile).

Success criteria (agreed):
- Integration: API-based integration ingesting 50k messages, end-to-end inference with embeddings + reranking
- Latency: p99 < 120ms for 1k concurrent sessions in pilot config
- Quality: 85%+ retrieval accuracy on the provided eval set (see attached)
- Cost: token/unit costs within the target above for the pilot workload

Ownership & timeline:
- Acme: provide eval dataset, SSO metadata (if using SAML), and IP allowlist for test environment by Fri 12/10
- Redwood (Marissa): provision initial scoped API key and send success-criteria workbook (attached) by EOD 12/08
- Redwood (Connor): set up SSO invite and document IP allowlist steps; provide short runbook for your infra by 12/09
- CS (Evelyn): schedule weekly 30-min syncs starting week of 12/13; run the evaluation checks and collect metrics

Access options we discussed (please confirm):
1) SSO (SAML): preferred for team access  send saml-metadata.xml to us and we'll push the invite
2) Scoped API key: temporary key for workload + IP allowlist (we'll scope to the pilot project)

Next steps (action items):
- Jane/Tom: confirm whether you want SSO or API key first and share the IP ranges you can allow (CIDR ok)
- Marissa: attach success criteria workbook and initial access plan (see attachment)
- Connor: will follow up with SSO invite + details on key scoping

Attachments: Acme-POC-success-criteria.xlsx

Thanks  I'll follow up once Connor has the SSO invite/API key provisioned.

Best,
